invention.test: const {sim,THREE:T}=game;const gate=game.entities.find(e=>e.id==='gate');assert(!!gate,'Courtyard gate exists');sim.player.setTranslation({x:-6,y:.85,z:0},true);sim.player.setLinvel({x:0,y:0,z:0},true);sim.manual={x:0,y:0,z:0};advance(2);function aim(e){const p=sim.position;const d=new T.Vector3(e.position.x-p.x,e.position.y-(p.y+.86),e.position.z-p.z).normalize();sim.aim={x:d.x,y:d.y,z:d.z};}aim(gate);const handle=gate.collider.handle;behavior.use();behavior.use();assert(game.root.children.filter(o=>o.name.startsWith('Flying RPG rocket')).length===1,'Cooldown prevents duplicate launch');advance(3);assert(!gate.removed,'Rocket must travel before destroying gate');const rocket=game.root.children.find(o=>o.name.startsWith('Flying RPG rocket'));assert(rocket&&rocket.position.x>-5.5,'Visible rocket flies forward');advance(32);assert(gate.removed&&!game.world.getCollider(handle),'Impact removes actual gate collider');const wall=game.entities.find(e=>e.id==='wall-right');assert(!wall.removed,'Distant wall survives gate blast');advance(10);aim(wall);behavior.use();assert(game.root.children.some(o=>o.name.startsWith('Flying RPG rocket')),'Launcher fires again after reload');advance(42);assert(wall.removed,'Second rocket blasts open a prison wall');
invention.name: Bad Decision RPG
invention.description: A shoulder launcher with fast, visible rockets, smoky exhaust, punchy firing feedback, and impact blasts that tear out nearby prison walls and gate sections.
invention.usage: Aim at the gate or a wall and press F/click. Fire again after the short reload. Stand back from impacts, then walk through the breach.
limitations: Close explosions can throw you backward.
Blasts demolish nearby structural sections; foundation ground and the rooftop platform remain intact.
